name: Stein Eriksen Residences Deer Valley
positioning: Modern ski-in/ski-out residences of condominiums and private homes, slopeside at Deer Valley Resort in Park City, Utah
best_for: Skiers who want ski-in/ski-out access at Deer Valley
Families and larger groups who want residential space and privacy

facts.text: Stein Eriksen Residences offer ski-in/ski-out access at Deer Valley Resort.
The property offers condominiums and private homes rather than standard hotel rooms.
The residences are five minutes from Stein Eriksen Lodge.
Facilities include a heated indoor/outdoor infinity pool, indoor/outdoor hot tubs and a whirlpool.
There is an expansive outdoor deck with seating and mountain and valley views.
Silver Aspen Spa is on site and offers massages and facials.
Stein Eriksen Sport, a shop with equipment, clothing and accessories, is open for the winter season.
The setting combines skiing with mountain biking.
Seasonal specials align with winter skiing and summer alpine activities.
Fall is peak leaf-peeping season in Park City.
All stays include the breakfast buffet at the 7880 Club.
Private chef services are available by request, with customized meals prepared in the residence.

highlights.text: The residences sit slopeside at Deer Valley Resort in Park City, Utah, with direct mountain access in a private residential setting.
The spa sits next to an indoor/outdoor infinity pool with mountain views.
Residences include condominiums and penthouse-style residences with spacious layouts, as well as private homes ideal for large groups or extra privacy.
The residences feel modern and homey, a departure from a traditional ski lodge.

considerations.text: Silver Aspen Spa guests and treatments are restricted to ages 18 and over.
This is a residential stay in condominiums and private homes, not a traditional ski lodge; Stein Eriksen Lodge is five minutes away.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury resort positioning.
